data.name: Asmae
data.gender_notes: Asmae is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Asmae is an Arabic name for boys and girls, derived from the word 'asma' which means 'supreme'. The name Asmae carries the meaning “Supreme” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Asmae usually hope their child will grow to embody supreme and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Asmae is one of the 99 names of Allah, signifying 'the all-encompassing'.
data.etymology: Asmae belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Supreme.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Asmae total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_urdu.name: اسماء
in_urdu.meaning: اسماء عورتوں کے لیے ایک شاندار نام، جس کا مطلب ہے "خواتین کے نام"
in_urdu.long_meaning: اسماء ایک بہت اچھا نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے "خواتین کے نام" اس نام کا تعلق عربیت سے ہے جس کا اہم کردار ہے۔ اسلامی روایات میں خواتین کو بہت اچھا مقام دیا گیا ہے۔ خواتین کی بہادری اور شہرت کے لیے اسماء ایک بہت اچھا نام ہے۔

in_hindi.name: अस्मा
in_hindi.meaning: अस्मा एक पवित्र नाम है, जिसका अर्थ है "महिलाओं के नाम"
in_hindi.long_meaning: अस्मा एक अच्छा नाम है जिसका अर्थ है "महिलाओं के नाम" इस नाम का संबंध अरबी भाषा से है जो एक महत्वपूर्ण भूमिका निभाती है। इस्लामिक परंपराओं में महिलाओं को अच्छा स्थान दिया गया है। महिलाओं की बहादुरी और प्रसिद्धि के लिए अस्मा एक अच्छा नाम है।

data.cultural_impact: The name Asmae is not only aesthetically beautiful, but it also carries a rich cultural significance. It is a name that has been cherished by Muslims for centuries due to its association with noble qualities and revered Islamic figures. For instance, Asma bint Abu Bakr, a prominent lady in the early Muslim community, who was known for her excellent character, generosity, and devotion to the Prophet Muhammad PEACE BE UPON HIM. The name Asmae, therefore, evokes the pride and honor that comes from having a heritage steeped in Islamic values and traditions.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Asmae is deeply meaningful as it conveys a sense of connection to the divine. Asma, the root of the name, carries the sense of godliness and excellence. Muslims believe that Allah (God) is the ultimate As(ma), the superlative one, the most supreme being, and the giver of all excellence. Therefore, for Muslims, the name Asmae symbolizes the highest form of closeness to Allah and the realization of the divine presence in everyday life. It serves as a constant reminder of the goal of striving for excellence in all aspects of life while staying in submission to Allah.
